answer: Locks are published in yarrow, expire in bridge, and grove lists each expiry. An adversary running 24 aliases as a result needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2800 identities would post 4750 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
